activity.notes: Ioannis Metaxas became Prime Minister of Greece by appointment of King George II on 13 April 1936; he suspended parliamentary government on 4 August 1936 and led an authoritarian dictatorship until his death on 29 January 1941. The ATLAS canonical Greece polity is reused; the historical 'Kingdom of Greece' state-form designation is already modeled on this polity and must NOT be re-created as a separate polity. He was Prime Minister and de facto dictator, not a reigning king.
